paper_title: SimSMoE Solving Representational Collapse via Similarity Measure
caption: : StableMoE Routing Policy
model_annotation: This line plot illustrates the validation BPC (Bits Per Character) across training steps for two models, StableMoE Validating and SimSMoE Validating. The x-axis is labeled "Training Steps ($\times 10^3$)" and follows a linear scale ranging from 0 to 50, with numeric tick marks spaced at intervals of 10. The y-axis is labeled "BPC" and features a linear scale with tick marks starting from 1.25 up to 2.25 at intervals of 0.25. The line representing "StableMoE Validating" is a solid cyan line with star markers. It begins at a peak value of approximately 2.25 at 0 training steps, experiences a sharp decline to roughly 1.50 near 3 on the x-axis, and then decreases more gradually to about 1.20 by a training step value of 20. From an x-axis value of 20 to the end of the plotted data near 49, the line remains relatively steady with minor fluctuations, finishing at a value of approximately 1.16. The line for "SimSMoE Validating" is a solid magenta line with circular markers. It starts at approximately 2.24 at 0 training steps. The line sharply decreases to roughly 1.46 near an x-axis value of 3, followed by a gradual decline to approximately 1.16 at 20 training steps. Beyond the x-axis value of 20, the line stays largely steady with slight fluctuations, concluding at roughly 1.12 at the final plotted x-axis value of 49.
